title: NIC Tuning & Refinement Update
headline: App Booster replaced by NIC Tuning, Power Plan intent persistence fixed, and Settings cleaned up.
changes: Added: NIC Tuning is now a first-class feature — replaces App Booster everywhere in the app, website, and marketing. Adapter-level interrupt moderation, RSS queue tuning, and driver power management in one place.
Fixed: Power Plan System Intent selection now persists across sessions — your chosen intent (Competitive, Efficiency, or Balanced) is remembered and restored correctly on next launch.
Removed: App Booster feature has been retired. All per-adapter network optimizations are now handled through NIC Tuning.
Removed: Game session notifications setting removed from Settings — the sentinel loop now handles telemetry pausing silently.
Improved: Settings page is cleaner with fewer redundant toggles.
